description: Clears sources.architectures.revision so src/components/ReferenceArchitectures/index.js takes the absent-revision guard at src/components/ReferenceArchitectures/index.js:15 -- SyncStatus returns null and the whole provenance line goes with it. The field is a scalar on a singleton object of the one file the one /architectures page reads, so clearing it in the ordinary coverage build would not add a case: it would take src/components/ReferenceArchitectures/index.js:16-31 with it, including the `on ${syncDate}` arm the real build is the only one to reach. It cannot share the variant build either, which clears metrics.generatedAt to reach the ': null' syncDate arm at src/components/ReferenceArchitectures/index.js:18 -- that arm is inside the guard this overlay closes, so one build cannot hold both shapes. That standoff is why the fixture mechanism takes a directory per build rather than a fixed second one. metrics.generatedAt is deliberately left present here: with it cleared this build would cover nothing the variant does not. The same overlay clears sources.architectures.repository, which is what makes DirectoryFreshness render the plain-text 'cncf/architecture' arm of its link ternary (src/components/MemberDirectory/DirectoryFreshness.js line 44) instead of the anchor at src/components/MemberDirectory/DirectoryFreshness.js:40. That arm needs the architectures sentence to render -- metrics.generatedAt present -- while the repository URL is absent, so it cannot go in the variant build, which clears generatedAt and drops the sentence entirely, nor in the ordinary coverage build, whose anchor is the one tests/e2e/member-directory-freshness.spec.js asserts. It rides here rather than in a build of its own because this build already holds metrics.generatedAt present, and ReferenceArchitectures returns at its revision guard before it reads repository, so clearing the field un-covers nothing this build reaches and adds no compile to the end-to-end coverage job.
